verdict.rationale: Admin docs show companies can toggle on "Allow exercises through the AngelList platform" and link a bank account to the equity plan, which implies online exercise with payment collection. Recipients can also accept securities by e-signature and track options on a dashboard. However, the update FAQ says companies are being moved to other cap table providers (J.P. Morgan, Pulley), which casts doubt on whether this capability is ongoing. Missing for 10: an employee-side description of the exercise and payment flow, explicit documentation that shares are issued automatically after exercise, independent or hands-on corroboration, and clarity on product continuity given the transition notice.
